publish.venue: The Village of Baytowne Wharf at Sandestin Golf and Beach Resort
publish.address: 9100 Baytowne Wharf Blvd, Miramar Beach, FL 32550
publish.card_hook: The 40th annual wine festival returns to The Village of Baytowne Wharf with tastings, food and live entertainment.
publish.verify_note: 2026-09-22: sandestinwinefestival.com states the 40th annual festival runs April 9 to 11, 2027 at The Village of Baytowne Wharf, with the Grand Wine Tasting 5 to 8 PM; tickets via sd.bigtickets.com.

publish.card_hook: Live bands play Florida Sand Music Ranch for a weekend of camping, day passes and gate ticket sales.
publish.verify_note: 2026-09-22: rocknrollrevival.org states the festival runs April 16 to 18, 2027 at Florida Sand Music Ranch, 85 Myers Road, Brooksville, with day passes and gate ticket sales.

publish.card_hook: Over 170 juried artists show work along Tallahassee's Chain of Parks with live entertainment and food vendors.
